topic: Nasdaq-100 market sentiment & news (for post-National-Day probability analysis)
note: Today is 2026-10-03 (Sat). News items are from Oct 1-2, 2026. Crypto sentiment API returned null (no data).

macro_fed.item: Fed cut rates by 25 bps to 4.00%-4.25%, first cut since December. 2026 unemployment projection lowered to 4.4%; PCE inflation projection raised to 2.6% for 2026.
Fed funds target range at 3.75%-4.00%; 10-yr Treasury yield 4.94% (near 24-year highs). S&P 500 at 7,637, ~2% below record high.
Dollar Index (DXY) setting new 2026 highs on rate-hike expectations, approaching 102 (highest since early 2025). Bond yields near 24-year highs.

tech_earnings.item: Tech showed muscle for 2nd straight day, supporting broader market despite high yields. Investors mulling Micron's results, awaiting Friday's jobs report.
Micron (MU) earnings in focus; Vicor (VICR) +12% on raised Q3 outlook; Jabil (JBL) -10% despite strong AI demand outlook; Conagra (CAG) -5% on volume drop.
Mega-cap tech higher: Nvidia +2.1%, Apple +0.7%, Microsoft +1.1%, Amazon +1.8%, Broadcom +2%, Meta +0.6%, Tesla +3.9%. S&P 500 rose to 7720 (+0.70%).

market_context.item: S&P 500 down 1.2% on the week (worst weekly performance since August); Dow -1.8% on the week. Oil price decline supported bond market and equities. Consumer discretionary and tech outperformed.

S&P 500 revenues growing ~10%, operating margins ~16% (all-time high), driven largely by tech/AI. Tech valuations not stretched while earnings growth rising. Risk: oil/energy prices could push yields and inflation higher, limiting Fed's ability to cut.

bullish_factors: Fed cut rates 25 bps to 4.00%-4.25% (first cut since Dec) - dovish tilt
Strong tech/AI earnings momentum; mega-cap tech broadly higher
Corporate margins near all-time highs; optimistic business outlook
Oil price decline easing inflation pressure, supporting bonds/equities
bearish_factors: 10-yr Treasury yield near 24-year highs (~4.94%) - headwind for growth/tech
DXY at 2026 highs (~102) on rate-hike expectations - mixed Fed signal
PCE inflation projection raised to 2.6% for 2026 - limits further cuts
S&P 500 had worst weekly performance since August (down 1.2% on the week)
sentiment_summary.overall: Mixed-to-cautiously-bullish. Dovish Fed cut and strong AI/tech earnings support upside, but elevated bond yields, a strong dollar, and sticky inflation cap the rally. Market is near record highs with elevated volatility.
